title: Figures 4-5: Supersonic Flow Past a Wedge-Shaped Body and a Blunt Body (Spheroid)
description: Figure 4 shows a blue wedge in supersonic flow (M1 > 1) with an attached 'Bow Shockwave' at angle β, wedge half-angle θ, 'Region 1' and 'Region 2', expansion fans and a 'Turbulent Wake'. Figure 5 shows a red sphere labeled 'Blunt Body' with a curved 'Detached Shock' upstream, subsonic flow behind the shock (M2 < 1), 'Expansion Fans' and a 'Turbulent Wake'.
